description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340016238342 PLATE,MOUNTING: Line 0001 Qty 233 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0102 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). Quotes must be submitted electronically.
